main_text.p: נכרה Hiphil הִכָּה Pihel נִכַּר Percussit, Cæcidit: metaph. Propagavit, Diffudit.
Pyhal נֻכָּה. Hophal הוּכָּה & Niphal נִכָּה Percussus, Cæsus fuit.
נָכֶה m. Percussus, Lasus. נְכִים Loripedes.
מַכָּה f. Plaga: plur. מַכּוֹת & מַכִּים.
נֶכַח נֹכַח Coram, E regione, Ex adverso.
נֵלְחַ m. Aequitas, Rectitudo: plur. נִלְחִים Fœm. נִלְחָה plur. נִלְחוֹת.
נָכַל Pihel & Hithpahel הִתְנַכֵּל Machinari, Callide agere.
נְכָסִים נְכָס m.p. Opes, Facultates. Chald. נְכָסִין.

נָכַר Pihel Agnovit: item, Alienavit, Alienum reddidit, Alienè se gessit: Tradidit. Niphal נִכַּר Agnitus fuit: Alium se simulavit. Hiphil הִכִּיר Agnovit, Cognovit. Hithpahel הִתְנַכֵּר Cognoscendum se præbuit: Extraneum egit, Alienum se finxit.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some letters in the scan are blurred and worn; the vocalisation of several entries (notably the first Hebrew words of the Hiphil/Pihel line, the plural forms and the Chaldaic word) is uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The running head is only a fragment of Hebrew letters. The left edge carries no text but show-through and damage.
